messages:
Maya (eng-sre): FYI APAC AZ-a failing GPU node joins after the keystore OPA policy push a few mins ago. pods stuck in Init
Raj (eng-infra): saw that, any error codes?
Maya (eng-sre): kubelet logs show decrypt failures + connection refused to priv-keystore endpoint. snippet: `ERROR decrypt: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied`
Raj (eng-infra): hmm permission denied from keystore -> OPA policy probably denied egress to the keystore shard for that AZ
OpsBot: [ALERT] node-join-failures: 11 nodes failed in apac-az-a in last 3m
Priya (eng-platform): rolling back the OPA change would blow up audit surface. can we do a targeted exception?
Lin (eng-security): we tightened egress to keystore for lateral auth, but intended to allow NLB subnets. looks like the rule missed the new warm-pool ENIs in AZ-a
Maya (eng-sre): impact: new workloads can't start on reserved GPU pools. We already see capacity fallback to other regions which is going to spike costs.
Raj (eng-infra): quick mitigation: add a short-lived policy exception for keystore egress from apac-az-a ENI prefix. Doing a canary update to OPA now.
Priya (eng-platform): patch me the policy diff, we need justification for the exception in the audit ticket (INC-5135).
Raj (eng-infra): patch:
```yaml
- allow: keystore/egress
  when: src_subnet in [\"10.240.18.0/24\"]
  ttl: 10m
  reason: temp-allow-keystore-warm-pool-az-a
```
Maya (eng-sre): applied to opa-canary, starting node re-joins. first node re-joined at +38s
Lin (eng-security): I opened an audit entry and flagged TTL. We need postmortem: why subnet discovery wasn't included in the rule.
Priya (eng-platform): ops note: cost forecast for the temporary cross-region failover ~ +$12k/day if we kept failing, so the exception saved money + SLOs. Add that to the ticket.
Maya (eng-sre): follow-ups: (1) make OPA policy generator include warm-pool ENIs (2) add integration test that simulates new ENI prefixes, (3) ensure keystore service returns clearer error codes for authz vs network issues
Raj (eng-infra): creating PR to update policy generator and adding unit test. link: https://git.internal/r/projects/infra/pulls/412
Lin (eng-security): also propose a 'preflight' OPA dry-run for infra pushes that would have flagged deny against active ENIs. I'll sketch the proposal today.
Maya (eng-sre): thanks all. leaving the canary exception in place for 10m, will revoke after warm-pool stabilizes. Monitoring: watch join-rate, decrypt-error-rate, and audit-sink for the TTLed exception. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: [INFO] policy-exception-applied by Raj (canary id: opa-canary-77)
Priya (eng-platform): closing loop: file INC-5135 with timeline, cost estimate, and action items.
Maya (eng-sre): closing thread once exception revokes cleanly.
